def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    product_set = set(entity_ids)
    mask = order_items["product_id"].isin(product_set) & (order_items["ts"] < seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask, ["order_id", "product_id", "seller_id", "price", "freight_value", "ts"]].copy()

    feature_names = [
        "order_count", "unique_orders", "unique_customers", "unique_sellers",
        "total_price", "avg_price", "std_price", "max_price", "min_price",
        "total_freight", "avg_freight",
        "cnt_30", "cnt_60", "cnt_90",
        "cnt_30_days", "cnt_60_days", "cnt_90_days",
        "canceled_share", "delivered_share",
        "avg_review", "std_review", "total_reviews",
        "avg_installments", "avg_payment_value",
        "credit_share", "debit_share", "voucher_share",
        "last_purchase_days", "first_purchase_days", "avg_daily_orders",
        "review_recency_days", "delivered_recency_days",
    ]

    def empty_result():
        result = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=list(entity_ids), columns=feature_names)
        return result.reindex(entity_ids)

    if items.empty:
        return empty_result()

    # статусы на момент seed_time:
    # delivered учитываем только если доставка уже случилась до seed_time
    # canceled учитываем только если отмена зафиксирована (заказ не доставлен после seed_time
    # и его покупка была достаточно давно); используем только прошлое
    orders_sub = orders[["order_id", "customer_id", "order_status",
                         "order_delivered_customer_date"]].copy()
    items = items.merge(orders_sub, on="order_id", how="left")

    items["is_delivered"] = (
        (items["order_status"] == "delivered")
        & (items["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna())
        & (items["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    ).astype(int)

    # canceled: статус отмены мог быть проставлен позже seed_time.
    # консервативно: считаем отменённым, если статус canceled и это известно
    # (заказ не мог быть доставлен после seed_time, т.к. доставка ещё не была)
    items["is_canceled"] = (
        (items["order_status"] == "canceled")
        & ~(items["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
            & (items["order_delivered_customer_date"] >= seed_time))
    ).astype(int)

    # платежи: только те, что существуют на момент seed_time
    pay_hist = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    pay_agg = pay_hist.groupby("order_id").agg(
        install_mean=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        total_pay=("payment_value", "sum"),
        credit_share=("payment_type", lambda s: (s == "credit_card").mean()),
        debit_share=("payment_type", lambda s: (s == "debit_card").mean()),
        voucher_share=("payment_type", lambda s: (s == "voucher").mean()),
    )

    # отзывы: только созданные до seed_time
    rev_hist = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
    rev_agg = rev_hist.groupby("order_id").agg(
        rev_count=("review_id", "count"),
        rev_avg=("review_score", "mean"),
        rev_std=("review_score", "std"),
        rev_last=("review_creation_date", "max"),
    )

    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    items["cnt_30"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_60"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_90"] = (items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)).astype(int)
    items["cnt_30_days"] = items["cnt_30"] * items["price"]
    items["cnt_60_days"] = items["cnt_60"] * items["price"]
    items["cnt_90_days"] = items["cnt_90"] * items["price"]

    g = items.groupby("product_id")
    feat = g.agg(
        order_count=("order_id", "count"),
        unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        total_price=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        cnt_30=("cnt_30", "sum"),
        cnt_60=("cnt_60", "sum"),
        cnt_90=("cnt_90", "sum"),
        cnt_30_days=("cnt_30_days", "sum"),
        cnt_60_days=("cnt_60_days", "sum"),
        cnt_90_days=("cnt_90_days", "sum"),
        canceled_share=("is_canceled", "mean"),
        delivered_share=("is_delivered", "mean"),
        avg_review=("rev_avg", "mean"),
        std_review=("rev_std", "mean"),
        total_reviews=("rev_count", "sum"),
        avg_installments=("install_mean", "mean"),
        avg_payment_value=("total_pay", "mean"),
        credit_share=("credit_share", "mean"),
        debit_share=("debit_share", "mean"),
        voucher_share=("voucher_share", "mean"),
        max_ts=("ts", "max"),
        min_ts=("ts", "min"),
        max_rev_ts=("rev_last", "max"),
        max_deliv_ts=("order_delivered_customer_date", "max"),
    )

    feat["last_purchase_days"] = (seed_time - feat["max_ts"]) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    feat["first_purchase_days"] = (seed_time - feat["min_ts"]) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    feat["avg_daily_orders"] = feat["order_count"] / feat["first_purchase_days"].clip(lower=1)
    feat["review_recency_days"] = (seed_time - feat["max_rev_ts"]) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    feat["delivered_recency_days"] = (seed_time - feat["max_deliv_ts"]) / pd.Timedelta(days=1)

    feat = feat.drop(columns=["max_ts", "min_ts", "max_rev_ts", "max_deliv_ts"])

    feat = feat.reindex(columns=feature_names)

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(list(entity_ids), name="product_id"))
    result = result.join(feat, how="left")
    result = result.fillna(0.0)
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    return result
